description: The rest of the built work: treadmills that programme their own LEDs, a touch map, a glass car wired for current.
story: Where the first room proves the studio can build, this one proves it can build at scale and on a brand's terms — adidas across three pieces, an electric-vehicle energy flow rendered in LED, and a projection room you stand inside.
